package outsidequestions

import framework.dsl.*
import framework.dsl.Finite.given
import framework.dsl.outcomes.Outcome

object ExplorationFixture:
  var calls = Vector.empty[String]
  def observed(label: String): Boolean =
    calls :+= label
    true
  class Model(bad: Boolean = false) extends Machine[Outcome, Boolean]:
    var count = 0
    val gap = hole
    object client extends Actor:
      lazy val increment = action
    object transitions extends Transitions:
      on(client.increment):
        if observed("guard") && count < 3 then effects.increment()
    object effects:
      def increment(): Unit =
        val _ = observed("effect")
        count = count + 1
        records(true)
    object invariants:
      val safe =
        check(observed("claim") && (!bad || count < 2))
  val instance = new Model
  class BudgetSuite(instance: Model) extends ModelSuite(instance):
    object examples:
      test("budgeted replay"):
        model.client.increment()
        expect(model.count == 1)
    object explorations:
      val space = explore(steps = 3):
        model.client.increment
      test("budgeted find"):
        space.find(steps = 2):
          expect(model.count == 99)
      test("budgeted sample"):
        space.sample(3, seed = 19L)
  class Multiple extends Machine[Outcome, Nothing]:
    var count = oneOf(Vector(0, 2))
    object transitions extends Transitions
  class StartSuite(instance: Multiple) extends ModelSuite(instance):
    var acquisitions = 0
    def selected: State =
      acquisitions += 1
      model.init.copy(count = 2)
    object explorations:
      val space = explore(steps = 2):
        any
      test("find from selected start", from = selected):
        space.find(steps = 1):
          expect(model.count == 2)
      test("sample from selected start", from = selected):
        space.sample(2, seed = 2L)

class PublicExplorationSuite extends ModelSuite(ExplorationFixture.instance):
  object examples:
    test("ordinary run"):
      model.client.increment()
      expect(model.count == 1)
  object explorations:
    val space = explore(steps = 3):
      model.client.increment
    test(munit.TestOptions("positioned find")):
      space.find(steps = 2):
        expect:
          ExplorationFixture.observed("target")
          model.count > 0
          model.count == before.count + 1
          outcome == Outcome.accepted
          records(true)
    test("seeded walks"):
      space.sample(3, seed = 19L)

class ExplorationClientTest extends munit.FunSuite:
  private def run(suite: munit.FunSuite): org.junit.runner.Result =
    new org.junit.runner.JUnitCore().run(
      org.junit.runner.Request.runner(new munit.MUnitRunner(suite.getClass, suite))
    )

  test("an exploration refuses executable statements before its question"):
    val errors = scala.compiletime.testing.typeCheckErrors("""
      import framework.dsl.*
      import framework.dsl.Finite.given
      import framework.dsl.outcomes.Outcome
      class Model extends Machine[Outcome, Nothing]:
        var count = 0
        object transitions extends Transitions
      val instance = new Model
      class Prefix extends ModelSuite(instance):
        object explorations:
          val space = explore(steps = 1):
            any
          test("mutates"):
            model.count = 99
            space.sample(1, seed = 1L)
    """)
    assert(errors.exists(_.message.contains("an exploration test requires one find or sample question")), errors.toString)
    assert(errors.forall(_.lineContent.nonEmpty))

  test("public sections register once without callbacks and execute the real questions"):
    ExplorationFixture.calls = Vector.empty
    val suite = new PublicExplorationSuite
    val registered = suite.munitTests()
    assertEquals(registered.size, 4)
    assertEquals(suite.munitTests().map(_.name), registered.map(_.name))
    assertEquals(ExplorationFixture.calls, Vector.empty)
    val library = sys.props.get("questions.library")
    library.foreach: path =>
      val origin = java.nio.file.Path.of(suite.explorations.space.getClass.getProtectionDomain.getCodeSource.getLocation.toURI)
      assertEquals(origin.toRealPath().toString, java.nio.file.Path.of(path).toRealPath().toString)
    if sys.props.contains("questions.declarations-only") then
      assert(Option(getClass.getClassLoader.getResource("framework/checker/Native$.class")).isEmpty)
      val result = run(suite)
      assertEquals(result.getRunCount, 4)
      assertEquals(result.getFailureCount, 4)
      assert(result.getFailures.toArray.forall(_.toString.contains("native execution requires the product checker module")))
      assertEquals(ExplorationFixture.calls, Vector.empty)
    else
      val result = run(suite)
      assertEquals(result.getRunCount, 4)
      assertEquals(result.getFailureCount, 0, result.getFailures.toString)
      assert(ExplorationFixture.calls.contains("target"))
      assert(ExplorationFixture.calls.contains("claim"))
      assertEquals(suite.model.count, 0)

  test("MUnit refuses notFound, unknown find, and a failing sampled claim"):
    if !sys.props.contains("questions.declarations-only") then
      val instance = new ExplorationFixture.Model
      class Missing extends ModelSuite(instance):
        object explorations:
          val space = explore(steps = 2):
            model.client.increment
          test("missing witness"):
            space.find(steps = 1):
              expect(model.count == 99)
      val missing = run(new Missing)
      assertEquals(missing.getRunCount, 2)
      assertEquals(missing.getFailureCount, 1)
      assert(missing.getFailures.toString.contains("notFound"))
      class Unknown extends ModelSuite(instance):
        object explorations:
          val space = explore(steps = 2):
            model.client.increment
          test("unknown target"):
            space.find(steps = 1):
              expect(model.count >= 0 && model.gap.reached)
      val unknown = run(new Unknown)
      assertEquals(unknown.getRunCount, 2)
      assertEquals(unknown.getFailureCount, 1)
      assert(unknown.getFailures.toString.contains("unknown"))
      val broken = new ExplorationFixture.Model(bad = true)
      class BadSample extends ModelSuite(broken):
        object explorations:
          val space = explore(steps = 3):
            model.client.increment
          test("bad sample"):
            space.sample(2, seed = 19L)
      val sampled = run(new BadSample)
      assertEquals(sampled.getRunCount, 2)
      assertEquals(sampled.getFailureCount, 2)
      assert(sampled.getFailures.toString.contains("refuted"))
      assert(sampled.getFailures.toString.contains("finite sample"))
      assertEquals(broken.count, 0)

  test("one exact concrete suite override reaches claims, replay, find and sample"):
    if !sys.props.contains("questions.declarations-only") then
      val suite = new ExplorationFixture.BudgetSuite(new ExplorationFixture.Model)
      assertEquals(suite.getClass.getName, "outsidequestions.ExplorationFixture$BudgetSuite")
      assert(sys.env.getOrElse("UMPIRE_CHECKER_BUDGETS", "").contains(suite.getClass.getName + "=1"))
      val result = run(suite)
      assertEquals(result.getRunCount, 4)
      assertEquals(result.getFailureCount, 4)
      val failures = result.getFailures.toArray.toVector.map(_.toString)
      assert(failures.forall(_.contains("unknown")), failures.mkString("\n"))
      assert(failures.forall(_.contains("budget 1 states")), failures.mkString("\n"))
      assertEquals(suite.model.count, 0)

  test("test-level from remains deferred and supplies both native question starts"):
    val suite = new ExplorationFixture.StartSuite(new ExplorationFixture.Multiple)
    assertEquals(suite.munitTests().size, 3)
    assertEquals(suite.acquisitions, 0)
    if !sys.props.contains("questions.declarations-only") then
      val result = run(suite)
      assertEquals(result.getRunCount, 3)
      assertEquals(result.getFailureCount, 0, result.getFailures.toString)
      assertEquals(suite.acquisitions, 2)
